title: India's Flooded Doors: A Simple Fix for Homeowners
summary: Heavy rainfall can cause wooden doors to swell, making them difficult to open or close. Homeowners can fix this issue by using a simple DIY method involving loose screws, lubricant, and reducing moisture.
summary_points: Heavy rainfall can cause wooden doors to swell, leading to difficulties with opening and closing.
A simple DIY method involves loosening screws, applying the right lubricant, and reducing moisture to fix the issue.
Homeowners can avoid hiring expensive carpenters by following this easy solution.
The method is suitable for various types of wooden doors.
Reducing moisture is key to preventing door swelling in rainy weather.
